capabilities: Capture quick notes into a single memo file with timeline, filters, and export
Manage tasks and projects in Gantt, Kanban, list, and calendar views
Search the whole vault with CJK-friendly full-text search and a persistent index
Sync the vault bidirectionally with OneDrive including encryption and safety guards
Render Dataview-style query blocks as tables, lists, and checkable task lists
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning from Obsidian staff; the search engine is described as re-implemented without reusing omnisearch's GPL code, and the sync engine is ported from an unnamed upstream sync project.
problem: Obsidian's dashboard, search, task tracking, and sync live in separate plugins and core features, so users must assemble many tools to get one workspace.

relations.evidence: recreating the omnisearch experience (UI only — no GPL code reused)
Graphical appearance settings for the Minimal theme (ported from obsidian-minimal-settings)
Clause order matches Dataview (FROM → WHERE → SORT → LIMIT)
Keep the entire vault in sync with OneDrive.

summary: Dashboard suite combining quick capture, task and project boards, calendar, full-text vault search, OneDrive sync, and Markdown enhancements.
